name: Hubble Deep Field
fact: The first deep-field photo: Hubble stared at an empty-looking patch of sky for ten days and found it full of very young galaxies.

name: Hubble Ultra-Deep Field
fact: Hubble's deepest look at the early universe, in a patch of sky about a tenth of the full Moon's width.

name: Hubble Deep Field South
fact: The southern-sky counterpart to the original Hubble Deep Field.

name: Webb's First Deep Field
fact: The James Webb Space Telescope's first full-colour image, centred on galaxy cluster SMACS 0723 (redshift 0.390). Its gravity magnifies galaxies far behind it.
